## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Python 3.12 or higher
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) package manager
- Git

### Development Setup

1. Fork the repository
2. Clone your fork:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/your-username/flights-mcp.git
   cd flights-mcp
   ```

3. Install dependencies:
   ```bash
   uv sync --dev
   ```

4. Run tests to verify setup:
   ```bash
   uv run python test_basic_functionality.py
   uv run python -m pytest tests/ -v
   ```

## How to Contribute

### Reporting Issues

- Use GitHub Issues to report bugs
- Provide detailed reproduction steps
- Include error logs and system information
- Search existing issues before creating new ones

### Submitting Changes

1. Create a feature branch:
   ```bash
   git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name
   ```

2. Make your changes and add tests
3. Run the test suite:
   ```bash
   uv run python -m pytest tests/
   ```

4. Check code formatting:
   ```bash
   uv run python -m black flights_mcp/
   uv run python -m isort flights_mcp/
   ```

5. Run type checking:
   ```bash
   uv run python -m mypy flights_mcp/
   ```

6. Commit your changes:
   ```bash
   git commit -m "feat: add your feature description"
   ```

7. Push to your fork:
   ```bash
   git push origin feature/your-feature-name
   ```

8. Create a Pull Request

### Code Style

- Use Black for code formatting (line length: 100)
- Use isort for import sorting
- Follow PEP 8 style guidelines
- Add type hints for new functions
- Include docstrings for public functions

### Testing

- Write unit tests for new functionality
- Test both success and error cases
- Use descriptive test names
- Mock external dependencies (API calls, etc.)

## Development Guidelines

### MCP Server Development

- Follow MCP protocol specifications
- Handle errors gracefully

- Return structured responses

### Flight Service Development

- Handle API rate limiting
- Implement retry logic

- Log API interactions
- Respect privacy and data usage

### Testing Guidelines

- Test all public functions
- Mock external API calls

- Keep tests independent

3. Update documentation if applicable
